intra.note: Correlations are computed inside each m=b-1 separately. Do not pool rows across moduli. Same-layer splits (delta_local>0 and n_digit_layers=1) are the obstruction to 'layers cause excess'.

bounds.note: A surviving upper bound must hold on every scored pair. N* always holds and is useless (slack ~ M). Cyc is a lower bound.

fit.note: log-log slope is not used; KS+xmin MLE only
